question:
Select the most appropriate word for the given group of words.

Impossible to deny or disapprove
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 1 **i.e.** Incontrovertible'**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase* "Impossible to deny or disapprove"* relates to** 'Incontrovertible'. **
 
• This word signifies something not able to be denied or disputed (निर्विवाद). 

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Incontrovertible'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Dubitable** means open to doubt or suspicion (संदेहापत्ति).
 
• **Frangible **means fragile (भंगुर).
 
• **Assailable **means not defended or capable of being defended (हल्ला करने योग्य).
